runtime: Python 3.13 primary with Python 3.14 compatibility gate; Windows x64 Beta 1.0

pst_ost_reader.design_rule: bundled, offline, read-only adapter only; no parser object crosses application boundary and parser output is normalized into LLD09 typed transient records before any matching/persistence logic
pst_ost_reader.release_pin: exact source revision/build artifact/hash is frozen in the release dependency manifest; release candidate must pass the LLD09 adapter golden corpus on supported Windows/Python matrix
forbidden: shelling to pffexport for authoritative parsing
using filesystem path/folder ordinal as canonical message identity
allowing parser exceptions/raw strings to enter diagnostics unsanitized

msg_writer.runtime_shape: pure Python; no Outlook, COM or native runtime dependency
msg_writer.release_hash: PyPI wheel/source hashes are frozen by the global release dependency manifest
msg_writer.verification: each produced artifact passes CFB/OXMSG structural verification plus independent-reader fixture tests; release candidate includes Outlook-on-Windows smoke fixtures
msg_writer.rule: writer creates IPM.Note draft artifacts only; it has no send/read authority

search_index.implementation: SQLite FTS5 contentless external-content projection over retained communication_id/subject/body normalized text
search_index.authority: rebuildable derived search material only; canonical content tables remain authority
search_index.purge_rule: orphan purge deletes corresponding search rows in same UnitOfWork before commit; no shadow/body copy survives

cryptography_security: no LLD09-owned cryptographic primitive; database encryption, session/authentication, deliberate action proof and diagnostic sink are LLD-12 authority
packaging: all parser/writer dependencies bundled offline under LLD-12 packaging manifest; no runtime download or plugin discovery
